cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Lake George, NY for Thanksgiving week, November 26–28, 2026, for a group of six adults.

specialist.summary: Three-day Thanksgiving week itinerary for six adults at Lake George, NY (November 26–28, 2026) with a historic steamboat cruise, lake kayaking, mini-golf, and dining at Mario's and Sushi Yoshi, featuring typical November temperatures of 46°F high and 33°F low.

stops.title: Lake George Steamboat Company
stops.description: Take a scenic cruise on one of the Lake George Steamboat Company's authentic passenger vessels. Founded in 1817 and considered a local claim to fame, the cruises offer views of the historic lake and surrounding landscape. Adults $17–57; confirm open on Thanksgiving Day (seasonUnconfirmed).

stops.title: Mario's Restaurant
stops.description: Enjoy Italian cuisine at Mario's Restaurant (429 Canada Street), which has been serving guests since 1954. Full-service bar available. Call ahead for reservations as the restaurant is popular (seasonUnconfirmed; confirm hours for Thanksgiving).

stops.title: Lake George Kayak Company
stops.description: Rent kayaks from Lake George Kayak Company (5 Boathouse Ln, Bolton Landing) for a morning on the water. Explore the lake at your own pace, but be mindful of wind conditions that can affect paddling time. Confirm seasonal availability (seasonUnconfirmed).

stops.title: Sushi Yoshi
stops.description: Dine at Sushi Yoshi (1818 State Route 9), a hibachi steakhouse with authentic low tables positioned over hollow pits for traditional Japanese izakaya-style dining. Serves lunch and dinner seven days a week. Slightly pricey but a unique group experience (seasonUnconfirmed; confirm hours).

cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Savannah, GA, April 9–11, 2027, for two adults who like history and food.

specialist.summary: Your three-day Savannah itinerary blends colonial and Civil War history with acclaimed local cuisine, starting with iconic squares and parks, moving through plantation and cemetery exploration, and ending with Southern classics like boiled shrimp at a family-owned shack.

stops.title: Gallery Espresso
stops.description: Start your day with coffee, tea, sweets and sandwiches at this arty coffee shop with outside seating. Abundant local art on display feeds the soul while enjoying the historic square. Confirm it's open on your dates. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Forsyth Park
stops.description: Explore this large public park marking the southern edge of the Historic District, ringed with bed and breakfasts and crowned with a beautiful fountain—a filming location for Midnight in the Garden of Good & Evil. Stop for lunch at The Collins Quarter, the only restaurant inside Forsyth Park, which offers a great brunch menu and atmosphere. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: River Street
stops.description: Stroll the popular cobblestone street along the south bank of the Savannah River, lined with shops and restaurants. Visit the sculpture of the Waving Girl toward the east end—a piece of local lore and history. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Wormsloe Historic Site
stops.description: Visit this historic site featuring a beautiful avenue of live oak trees and a visitor's center with the history of the plantation. Explore trails along the marshes. Hours listed as Daily 9AM-5PM; $10 admission. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Bonaventure Cemetery
stops.description: Explore this atmospheric cemetery with Spanish moss-draped trees. Fans of 'The Book' will find Johnny Mercer's grave here, along with those of Conrad Aiken and other Southern notables. The view of the river is wonderful and creates a delightfully spooky atmosphere. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Saint Bibiana
stops.description: Fine Italian cuisine restaurant and cocktail lounge located in historic downtown Savannah in the Savannah Bardo Hotel at 700 Drayton St. Adorned with chic artwork, stunning chandeliering, and the full restoration and artistic touches of the original 1888 Savannah Mansion. Confirm it's open on your dates. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: City Market
stops.description: Visit this mixed-use project in the northwest corner of the Historic District. The four-block area was rehabilitated beginning in 1985, creating a facility that would be economically unreplicable today. Established as a destination with shops, galleries, and dining. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Georgia State Railroad Museum
stops.description: Features several vintage pieces of rolling stock, an operating model train layout, and an operating turntable. Located at 655 Louisville Rd. Hours listed as Daily 9AM-5PM; Adults $7.70. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Desposito's
stops.description: One of the few surviving family-owned shrimp shacks from a previous era, featuring the same secret-recipe dipping sauce used for more than half a century. Go for a taste of old-timey Southern boiled shrimp. Located at 3501 Macceo Dr, Thunderbolt, GA. Hours listed as Tue–Sat 5–10PM; confirm it's open on your dates.

activities.title: La Casa del Libro
activities.description: Museum of the art and history books through five centuries. A museum holding nearly 5,000 early works of manuscripts and books, some as from as old as the 15th century. This museum is most known for having two royal mandates signed by Ferdinand and Isabella co…

activities.title: El Asador, The Grill Old San Juan
activities.description: Puerto Rican cuisine at the entrance of Old San Juan, the heart of nightlife in the Old City. It is a two-level restaurant with an exterior patio.

activities.title: BUNS Burger Shop
activities.description: Great burgers with high quality beef. Over 40 beers, some on tap.

activities.title: Super Max
activities.description: A normal grocery store.

activities.title: Freshmart
activities.description: A natural foods-centric grocery store where, as you leave, you are wished to "have a healthy day!"

activities.title: La Bombonera
activities.description: Authentic local cuisine in an unassuming landmark atmosphere unchanged for decades. Serves lunch and dinner. Fresh pastries. Superlative coffee. Inexpensive.

activities.title: Ostra Cosa
activities.description: Reservations recommended. The ambience here is one of the most sensual and romantic in Old San Juan.
